Reviewer: Alan Whitcombe
Property: Kestrel Court Serviced Apartments
Dates of Stay: June 8–11
Rating: ★★☆☆☆

During my recent work trip to Leeds, I stayed at Kestrel Court for three nights. – [1] –. On the whole, I was very disappointed with my stay. To start with, the property charged me a nightly fee to keep my car in the rear courtyard. – [2] –. I would expect this to be covered by the price of the apartment. On top of that, I stopped at the reception counter to arrange for someone to ring my room at 5:30 A.M. the next day, but this never happened. – [3] –. As a result, I slept through my alarm and reached an important client visit late. Kestrel Court’s rooms and fittings are acceptable, but I would not advise staying there. – [4] –. You are very likely to find one that treats its guests far better.
